findings.evidence: "transition: transform 0.2s ease-out, box-shadow 0.2s ease-out;" appears in a long elementary CSS demonstration. Weighted by section length, the body is dominated by familiar UX principles, routine styling examples, aesthetic reminders and repeated persona declarations rather than expert-only knowledge.
findings.fix: Remove elementary CSS demonstrations and consolidate repeated persona declarations. Spend the remaining instructions on non-obvious critique decisions, evidence-quality checks and concrete project constraints learned from actual reviews. Preserve all author, research-source, version and license credits.

findings.evidence: Under "Must Fix (Critical)", the workflow includes "Research-backed issues (violates F-pattern, left-side bias)". This assigns critical severity from a general heuristic without first establishing an actual task failure or affected users.
findings.fix: Add a triage step that records the user task, observed failure, affected population, evidence confidence and implementation effort. Reserve Critical for demonstrated task blockers or accessibility failures; rank scan-pattern recommendations according to contextual evidence rather than automatically escalating them.

findings.evidence: "No alt text" appears in the Accessibility Sins list alongside other bare prohibitions. Although some later warnings explain consequences, much of this list lacks failure conditions, exceptions and environment-specific gotchas.
findings.fix: Add concise gotchas with mechanisms and remedies: decorative images need alt="" rather than descriptive announcements; CSS visual reordering can diverge from keyboard order; overflow clipping can hide focus indicators. Explain when each failure occurs and how to verify the correction.

findings.evidence: "## Aesthetic Guidance: Avoiding Generic Design" begins a 147-line section of detailed rules and examples, followed by substantial methodology and response-template sections. Even excluding attribution, the file exceeds 200 lines, and its frontmatter has no skills preload.
findings.fix: Move bulky aesthetic catalogs, CSS examples, detailed heuristics and extended templates into a dedicated preloaded skill, referenced through skills:. Keep the agent under 200 lines with its role, core review sequence, concise output contract and completion condition. Retain the complete attribution and license content.

findings.evidence: "Never use these generic fonts" bans Inter and default system fonts, while subsequent instructions require weight extremes and "3x+" size jumps. These universal constraints override brand context, readability and performance in a creative advisory task.
findings.fix: Make distinctive typography a default direction, not a prohibition. Allow established design systems, accessibility, language coverage, performance and user research to justify conventional fonts and restrained scales; require a context-specific rationale for departures.

findings.evidence: "Format every response like this:" supplies an explicit Markdown output format, but the body contains no sentence stating when the task is done.
findings.fix: Add: "The task is done when the supplied interface or design question has been assessed, findings have been prioritized with actionable fixes and clearly labeled evidence limitations, and the Markdown response includes the required sections and One Big Win."

findings.evidence: The good-feedback example concludes: "This will increase nav interaction rates by 20-40% based on typical A/B test results." Following the example turns an attention observation into a guaranteed conversion-related uplift without identifying a supporting experiment.
findings.fix: Keep the NN Group citation, but distinguish its observed attention findings from a navigation-performance hypothesis. Recommend testing alignment against a defined task or interaction metric, and provide quantified uplift only when a matching study or project experiment supports it.

findings.evidence: "Time to acquire target = distance / size" incorrectly states Fitts's Law as a direct ratio, which would produce incorrect quantitative conclusions if followed.
findings.fix: Retain the Fitts attribution and replace the formula with the Shannon formulation MT = a + b × log2(1 + D/W), defining distance, effective target width and empirically fitted constants. Alternatively, state only the qualitative relationship without presenting an incorrect equation.

findings.evidence: "Always cite sources - Include NN Group URLs, study names, research papers" has no failure branch for unavailable or unverifiable research, despite requiring evidence for every recommendation.
findings.fix: Add an explicit fallback: when research cannot be retrieved or verified, retain supplied citations but label them unverified, distinguish observations from hypotheses, disclose the evidence limitation and request supporting material rather than inventing studies or presenting unsupported claims as proven.
